build_graph_from_model: build a Graph object from a PyTorch nn.Module model to extract its computational graph
build_graph_batch: build a GraphBatch container from a list of Graph objects for batched graph processing
visualize_graph: visualize a computational graph using matplotlib with node labels and edge directions
compute_graph_properties: compute graph properties like average degree and average shortest path length
scatter_graphs_to_devices: scatter a GraphBatch across multiple CUDA devices for distributed graph processing
